targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS d,
  uniq(username) as "Total_Username",
  uniq(origin) as "Total_Origin",
  uniq(apphost) as "Total_EAA_APPS",
  uniq(cloudZone) as "Total_cloudZone",
  uniq(conUuid) as "Total_Connectors",  
  SUM(bytesIn) "Incoming",
  SUM(bytesOut) "Outgoing"
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)

  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'

GROUP BY  d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Users per APP; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    uniq(username) AS Total_Username,
    d
FROM (
    SELECT
        username,
        CASE
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
            WHEN datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
             AND datetime <  now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE
                THEN toStartOfMinute(now() - INTERVAL 45 MINUTE)
        END AS d
    FROM ${table}
    WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 75 MINUTE
      AND username != '-'
      AND ${generalescaping}
      AND $__adHocFilter()
) t
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d ASC
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Real time active users; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
  uniq(username) as Total_Username,
  toStartOfInterval(datetime, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS d
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 minute


  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  and username != '-'
  AND idpinfo IN ('LOGIN|F', 'MFA|MF')


GROUP BY  d
order by d asc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Failed logins; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  uniq(apphost) as Total_Apphost,
  toStartOfInterval(datetime, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS d
  FROM ${table}
  WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 minute


  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  and username != '-'

GROUP BY  d
order by d asc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=EAA_App in use; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT username, maxOrNull(datetime) AS Last_Access FROM ${table}
WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter() 

AND (
  urlPath = '/saml/sp/response' 
  AND 
  idpinfo = 'UNSPEC|D'
  AND
  username != '-'
)

AND username != '-'

GROUP BY username
ORDER BY Last_Access DESC
LIMIT ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Last ${querieslimit} logged in users; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT sum(bytesIn)*8/60 as Incoming, sum(bytesOut)*8/60 AS Outgoing, 
toStartOfInterval(datetime, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS d
FROM ${table} 
WHERE datetime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
AND ${generalescaping}
AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY d
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bandwidth Usage; du=${__user.login}'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    clientVersion,
    count() AS device_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        clientVersion,
        deviceName 
    FROM ${table_deviceinventory} 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(signalTimestamp)
      AND deviceName != '-'
      AND deviceName != ''
--      AND ${generalescaping}
--      AND $__adHocFilter()     
    ORDER BY signalTimestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1 BY deviceName
)
GROUP BY clientVersion
ORDER BY clientVersion
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Number of full client version; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    concat(extract(clientVersion, '(\\d+)'), '.*') AS major_version,
    count() AS device_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        clientVersion,
        deviceName
    FROM ${table_deviceinventory} 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(signalTimestamp)
      AND deviceName != '-'
      AND deviceName != ''
--      AND ${generalescaping}
--      AND $__adHocFilter()     
    ORDER BY signalTimestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1 BY deviceName
)
WHERE major_version != '.*'
GROUP BY major_version
ORDER BY device_count desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Number of major client version; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    extract(clientVersion, '(\\d+\\.\\d+)') AS major_minor_version,
    count() AS device_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        clientVersion,
        deviceName
    FROM ${table_deviceinventory} 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(signalTimestamp)
      AND deviceName != '-'
      AND deviceName != ''
--      AND ${generalescaping}
--      AND $__adHocFilter()  
    ORDER BY signalTimestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1 BY deviceName
)
WHERE major_minor_version != ''
GROUP BY major_minor_version
ORDER BY device_count desc 
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Number of minor client version; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
    clientVersion,
    deviceName,
    idpUsername,
    osName,
    osVersion,
    signalTimestamp as last_update
FROM (
    SELECT
        clientVersion,
        deviceName,
        osName,
        osVersion,
        signalTimestamp,
        idpUsername
    FROM ${table_deviceinventory} 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(signalTimestamp)
      AND deviceName != '-'
      AND deviceName != ''
--      AND ${generalescaping}
--      AND $__adHocFilter()     
    ORDER BY signalTimestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1 BY deviceName
)
GROUP BY clientVersion, deviceName, idpUsername, osName, osVersion, last_update
ORDER BY last_update desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} client version details; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    statusCode,
    count(*) AS "Total"
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY time, statusCode
ORDER BY time ASC, statusCode
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Status codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    toString(statusCode) AS statusCode,
    count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY  statusCode
ORDER BY Total desc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Status codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT

  AND ${generalescaping}

         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    toString(errorCode) AS errorCode,
    count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
GROUP BY  errorCode
ORDER BY Total desc
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Error codes; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
    sessionId,
    count(*) AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)
  AND ${generalescaping}
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND username != '-'
  AND sessionId != '-'
GROUP BY  sessionId
ORDER BY Total desc
limit ${querieslimit}
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60,
         hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ${querieslimit} session ID; du=${__user.login}';

SELECT
  $__timeInterval(datetime) AS time,
    httpMethod,
    count(*) AS "Total"
